description.value: Pacific Retreat is a three-bedroom oceanfront vacation rental home on the rugged west coast of Tofino, professionally managed by Tofino Vacation Rentals. The property offers sweeping ocean views, a hot tub, and an expansive cedar deck, with Tonquin Beach a ten-minute walk away. Its fully equipped kitchen, washer/dryer, and proximity to the village make it a comfortable self-catering basecamp for exploring Pacific Rim's beaches and rainforest trails.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content from tofinovr.com/properties/pacific-retreat/ provides a detailed amenity list for this professionally managed vacation rental. The amenities section explicitly includes 'Washer/Dryer' confirming laundry, and 'No Pets' confirming the pet policy, but makes no mention of bike storage, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific facilities. The village of Tofino is described as nearby and within easy walking distance, but no specific grocery or dining establishments are named, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM record had no phone number; phone sourced from management company website (Tofino Vacation Rentals) and may be a shared line for all properties rather than a direct number for this unit.
Property street address (311 Arnet Lane) is from OSM only — the website does not display the street address on the listing page, so it could not be independently confirmed.
A long-term caretaker tenant lives on-site in a separate suite per Tofino Bylaws; this unusual arrangement is noted on the website and may be relevant for cyclist guest expectations.
